summary: A seat whose host st cannot determine says so on its card and in st agents show instead of reading as starting

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; the card is computed from existing claims at read time.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; no client contract change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Additive: the open reason field of an agent card carries a sentence when reachability is indeterminate and the harness gave no reason. No state word, schema or generated client changes; clients that print reason show the sentence, others are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no additional startup work.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
